set(LIB_NAME copendaq)
opendaq_set_cmake_folder_context(TARGET_FOLDER_NAME copendaq)

# The sources are generated by run_rtgen.sh, which discovers the core interfaces on its own, so there
# is no list of files to keep in sync here either. CONFIGURE_DEPENDS re-runs the glob on every build, so
# newly generated bindings are picked up without re-configuring.
file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC_Headers CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/*.h)
file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC_Cpp     CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp)

# Everything under include/ is installed except the private headers.
set(SRC_Public_Headers ${SRC_Headers})
list(FILTER SRC_Public_Headers EXCLUDE REGEX "/include/private/")
list(FILTER SRC_Public_Headers EXCLUDE REGEX "/copendaq_private\\.h$")

add_library(${LIB_NAME} SHARED ${SRC_Headers} ${SRC_Cpp})
add_library(${SDK_TARGET_NAMESPACE}::${LIB_NAME} ALIAS ${LIB_NAME})

target_sources(${LIB_NAME}
    INTERFACE
    FILE_SET copendaq_interface_headers TYPE HEADERS
    BASE_DIRS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    FILES ${SRC_Public_Headers}
)

target_link_libraries(${LIB_NAME}
    PRIVATE
    daq::coretypes
    daq::coreobjects
    daq::opendaq
)

target_include_directories(${LIB_NAME}
    PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/>
)

target_compile_definitions(${LIB_NAME} PRIVATE BUILDING_SHARED_LIBRARY)

set(CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR bindings/C)

install(TARGETS ${LIB_NAME}
    EXPORT ${SDK_NAME}
    RUNTIME
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
        COMPONENT ${SDK_NAME}_${LIB_NAME}_Runtime
    LIBRARY
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
        COMPONENT ${SDK_NAME}_${LIB_NAME}_Runtime
        NAMELINK_COMPONENT ${SDK_NAME}_${LIB_NAME}_Development
    ARCHIVE
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
        COMPONENT ${SDK_NAME}_${LIB_NAME}_Development
    FILE_SET copendaq_interface_headers
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
        COMPONENT ${SDK_NAME}_${LIB_NAME}_Development
)

if(OPENDAQ_ENABLE_C_BINDINGS_TESTS)
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
